trades.name: Failure to sustain above 6865-6866 (today's high spike)
trades.quote: I would prefer to be short ES on a failure to sustain above 6865-6866 as compared to NQ, at least initially. This trade offers extremely well-defined risk and while lower probability does have a reasonably high potential for reward. Because of this, even given lower probability, I can still rate it a B+/A-.
